facts.claim: MSC World America (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2025; 216,638 GT; 5240 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 333 m length; World class.
World Class ships are a class of cruise ships being built by Chantiers de l'Atlantique of France for MSC Cruises.
The lead vessel, MSC World Europa, was delivered in October 2022 and the second, MSC World America, in March 2025.

catalogSpecs.description: World-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2025; 216,638 GT; approx. 5,240 guests at double occupancy.
